name: claude-kit
description: Eugenio Moreira's reusable Claude Code skills, agents and commands, enabled per project.

plugins.name: ck-frontend
plugins.description: Frontend conventions: clickable elements look and act clickable (real links/buttons, pointer cursor, focus states), any stack.

plugins.name: ck-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure conventions: Railway IaC in .railway/ (one TypeScript file per service, own package.json with plan/apply/deploy scripts), railway up deploys (no GitHub link), Dockerfile-built services and databases, role-based names like database / database-data.

plugins.name: ck-git
plugins.description: Git workflow: solo or team mode saved per project in .claude/git-workflow.json (asked once), commits and pushes straight to main unless a branch is explicitly asked for, and a Stop hook that has Claude ask to commit and push after every change.

plugins.name: ck
plugins.description: claude-kit tooling, installed once per user: /ck:setup picks and installs plugins for a project; /ck:sync asks which plugins to sync against (enabled or not, installed vs latest version), reviews the project against their latest rules and fixes it.
